description: Angular component for managing calculated field metrics panel in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, validation, and script testing.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldAggMetricValuePanel
classes.description: Extended interface for metric value with allowFilter property.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldMetricsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for the calculated field metrics panel, handling form logic, validation, and script testing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form with metric data, sets up validation, and adjusts form controls based on mode and read-only status.

methods.name: saveMetric
methods.description: Emits the current form value as the calculated metric, removing filter if allowFilter is false.

methods.name: updatedForm
methods.description: Adds unique name validator and removes defaultValue control if not in simple mode.

methods.name: observeFilterAllowChange
methods.description: Subscribes to allowFilter value changes to toggle filter validation.

methods.name: observeInputTypeChange
methods.description: Subscribes to input type changes to toggle input key and function validation.

methods.name: validateFilter
methods.description: Enables or disables the filter form control based on allowFilter.

methods.name: validateInputTypeFilter
methods.description: Enables or disables input key and function controls based on input type.

methods.name: validateInputKey
methods.description: Resets input key if it is invalid for the current arguments.

methods.name: onTestScript
methods.description: Calls the testScript function and updates the script expression in the form.
